$Comment: The Horseman's Greaves, one of the three plain pieces of his armour his daily Claim can pay (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily.json): the ancient steel he rode in. A member of the Hallowed set (ZiggfreedCommon/GearSets/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Hallowed.json). The game's ancient steel greaves model, with their recipe left out (they are never crafted) and their stats a step below the iron greaves', the way the Jack Helm sits below the iron helm, and one thing more: DamageBonus_Fire, Ziggfreed's CommonLib's stat for Fire damage the wearer deals, in whole percent points, so a Lantern Bomb or any fire weapon hits 3% harder with them on. Their flaming twin, Hallows_Eve_Flaming_Horseman_Greaves, is the Hoard's stronger copy on the same model. Light is the ember glow they give off. An Armor block written here replaces a parent's whole, so the file restates every leaf rather than naming a parent.
